scenarios.title: Finance ACH Payroll Export
scenarios.raw_requirements:
Finance ACH Payroll Export
1. The system must generate a balanced NACHA-style payroll file for approved payroll runs.
2. Each payroll batch must include company id, effective date, employee routing number, employee account number, and credit amount.
3. The export must reject payroll runs with missing routing numbers or negative amounts.
4. If file totals do not reconcile, the batch must fail before release.
5. Re-running the same payroll run must not create duplicate employee payments.

requirements.title: Generate ACH payroll file
requirements.description: Generate a balanced payroll export with required payment fields.

requirements.title: Reject invalid payroll rows
requirements.description: Reject rows with missing routing numbers or negative credit amounts.

requirements.title: Prevent duplicate payouts
requirements.description: Repeat export attempts for the same run must not create duplicate payments.

analysis_output.summary: Payroll ACH export requires valid payment rows, reconciled totals, and duplicate prevention.

test_cases.title: Generate balanced payroll file
preconditions: All employee banking details are present
test_cases.expected_result: A balanced export is generated with company and employee payment details.

test_cases.title: Reject negative payroll amount
preconditions: Approved payroll run contains a negative payment row
test_cases.expected_result: The batch is rejected before release and the invalid employee row is reported.

test_cases.title: Do not duplicate re-run payroll export
preconditions: An ACH export already exists for the payroll run
steps: Trigger the export for the same payroll run again
test_cases.expected_result: The system reuses or blocks the duplicate export and does not create duplicate payouts.

bug_reports.title: Negative payroll amounts are exported
bug_reports.description: The export allows negative credit rows to pass validation and release.
steps_to_reproduce: Prepare a payroll row with a negative amount
bug_reports.expected: The batch should fail before release.
bug_reports.actual: The batch is released with an invalid negative row.
bug_reports.suggested_fix: Validate routing and amount constraints before batch assembly.

scenarios.title: Health FHIR Intake Validation
scenarios.raw_requirements:
Health FHIR Intake Validation
1. The intake API must require a patient identifier, legal name, and date of birth before creating a patient record.
2. Observations must capture code, effective timestamp, value, and units when the observation is quantitative.
3. Requests missing mandatory demographic data must be rejected with a validation error.
4. Protected health information must never be written to debug logs.

requirements.title: Require patient demographics
requirements.description: Patient intake requires identifier, name, and date of birth.

requirements.title: Validate quantitative observations
requirements.description: Quantitative observations require code, timestamp, value, and units.

requirements.title: Do not log PHI
requirements.description: Sensitive demographics must not be emitted to debug logs.

analysis_output.summary: FHIR-style intake requires demographic validation, structured observations, and PHI-safe logging.

test_cases.title: Reject patient intake missing DOB
preconditions: Patient request is missing date of birth
test_cases.expected_result: The request is rejected with a validation error.

test_cases.title: Persist quantitative observation with units
preconditions: Observation includes code, timestamp, value, and units

test_cases.title: Debug logs omit PHI
test_cases.expected_result: Sensitive demographics are redacted or omitted from logs.

test_results.actual_result: Patient SSN appeared in debug log

bug_reports.title: PHI leaks into debug logging
bug_reports.description: The intake path logs patient demographics without redaction.
bug_reports.expected: Sensitive fields should be redacted or omitted.
bug_reports.actual: Sensitive patient data is written to logs.
bug_reports.suggested_fix: Redact PHI fields before structured logging.

scenarios.title: Hospitality Reservation Workflow
scenarios.raw_requirements:
Hospitality Reservation Workflow
1. The booking API must return room availability before accepting a reservation.
2. Reservations must include property id, room type, stay dates, guest count, and rate plan.
3. Duplicate booking submits with the same idempotency key must not create duplicate reservations.
4. A failed payment authorization must prevent the reservation from being confirmed.

requirements.title: Require reservation details
requirements.description: Reservations require property, room, dates, guest count, and rate plan.

requirements.title: Block duplicate confirmation
requirements.description: Repeated submits with the same idempotency key must not create duplicate reservations.

analysis_output.summary: Reservation workflow requires availability, complete booking data, and duplicate prevention.

test_cases.title: Confirm only available room inventory
preconditions: Inventory exists for requested stay dates
test_cases.expected_result: Reservation is confirmed only when inventory exists.

test_cases.title: Reject booking missing rate plan
test_cases.expected_result: Reservation request is rejected with validation details.

test_cases.title: Deduplicate repeated booking submit
preconditions: A reservation already exists for the idempotency key
steps: Submit booking request with the same idempotency key

test_results.actual_result: Two reservations were confirmed for the same key

bug_reports.title: Duplicate reservation created on idempotent retry
bug_reports.description: The booking flow confirms a second reservation for the same idempotency key.
steps_to_reproduce: Retry the same request with the same idempotency key
bug_reports.expected: The request should return the original reservation or block the retry.
bug_reports.suggested_fix: Persist and check idempotency keys before confirmation.

scenarios.title: Retail GTIN Catalog Sync
scenarios.raw_requirements:
Retail GTIN Catalog Sync
1. Each product must carry a unique GTIN before publication.
2. The catalog importer must reject duplicate GTINs in a single import batch.
3. Inventory labels must preserve barcode and batch metadata for downstream fulfillment.
4. Invalid GTIN lengths must be rejected before publication.

requirements.title: Require unique GTIN
requirements.description: Products need a unique GTIN before publication.

requirements.title: Reject duplicate GTINs
requirements.description: Importer must reject duplicate GTINs in the same batch.

requirements.title: Reject invalid GTIN length
requirements.description: Importer must fail records with invalid GTIN length before publication.

analysis_output.summary: Catalog sync requires unique and valid GTINs plus preserved fulfillment metadata.

test_cases.title: Publish product with unique GTIN
preconditions: Incoming product has a unique GTIN
test_cases.expected_result: Product is published with barcode metadata preserved.

test_cases.title: Reject duplicate GTIN batch
preconditions: Import batch contains the same GTIN twice
test_cases.expected_result: Batch fails with duplicate GTIN error.

test_cases.title: Reject short GTIN
preconditions: Incoming GTIN is shorter than expected
